instagram.caption:
Konark mandir ke upar 52 ton ka chumbak tha? 🤯
Lok kahani kehti hai murti hawa mein tairti thi aur jahaaz kinare kheenche aate the.
Historians kehte hain aise chumbak ka koi record nahi, par pahiya sach mein dhoop ghadi hai.
Aapko kya lagta hai, chumbak sirf kahani thi?
Us dost ko bhejo jo kehta hai Konark mein jahaaz chumbak se doobte the.

sheet.summary: According to local legend, a bleeding black stone washed ashore during floods 300 years ago, leading villagers to install it on a roofless platform and leave their homes without doors under Lord Shani's protective watch. Archaeological excavations in Nevasa taluka by Deccan College revealed deep prehistoric sequences along the Pravara River, while modern institutions like UCO Bank and a local police station accommodated village tradition by opening without conventional door locks. Experts and officials sharply disagree with the popular claim of a crime-free utopia, as regional police registries document multiple formal theft and burglary cases that local accounts dispute or disown. What remains unknown is the precise geological source of the central basalt monolith and whether the absence of doors began as an ancient ritual covenant or evolved from early modern agrarian living arrangements.
